evals.name: wave-subagents-stay-off-git
evals.prompt: You are running the implement stage of run feat-x. Your input is { "workspace": { "repos": [{ "name": "app", "worktreeDir": "/repo/.worktrees/feat-x" }] } }. The plan's digraph is p1 -> p2, p1 -> p3, and phase 1 is already committed. Phase 2 changes src/export/csv.ts and its test; phase 3 changes src/import/parse.ts and its test.
evals.expected_output: Builds phases 2 and 3 as one wave with a sub-agent each, then runs the checks and commits each phase separately.
expectations: Dispatches the phase 2 and phase 3 sub-agents in one message, in the same worktree
Each sub-agent prompt says not to run git add, commit, stash, checkout or reset, and not to run its E2E test
After both return, runs the full tests, typecheck and lint once
Makes two commits, phase 2 then phase 3, each staging only the files its sub-agent returned
anti_expectations: A sub-agent runs git add or git commit
One commit holds both phases' files
Builds phase 2 to completion before starting phase 3

evals.name: shared-file-builds-in-sequence
evals.prompt: You are running the implement stage of run feat-y. Your input is {}. The plan's digraph has phases 1 and 2 with no edge between them, but phase 1's diffs change src/api/routes.ts and phase 2's diffs also change src/api/routes.ts.
evals.expected_output: Notices that both phases change src/api/routes.ts and builds them one after the other instead of in one wave.
expectations: Names src/api/routes.ts as the file both phases change
Builds phase 1, commits it, then builds phase 2

evals.name: e2e-not-met-by-unit-test
evals.prompt: Implement phase 1 of the plan at .yok/feat-z/artifacts/plan.md. Its ### E2E block has SC4: exporting 3 invoices downloads a CSV with 3 rows. The unit test for the CSV writer already checks 3 rows. The configured environment starts fine.
evals.expected_output: Writes and runs an E2E test for SC4 through the running app, and the runner writes the phase's e2e report.
expectations: Writes an E2E test titled with SC4 that drives the export end to end
Runs it and the runner writes .yok/feat-z/artifacts/phase-1-e2e.json
anti_expectations: Counts the unit test as covering SC4
Writes phase-1-e2e-skipped.md for a phase that changes behavior seen from outside

evals.name: commit-but-never-push
evals.prompt: Implement the change in this ticket: add a --json flag to the export command. You can commit when it's done.
evals.expected_output: Builds the flag test-first, commits it, and stops without pushing.
expectations: Writes a failing test for --json before the code
Commits the change without asking again

evals.name: reads-yaml-config
evals.prompt: You are running the implement stage of run feat-w. Your input is {}. The repo root has orchestrate.config.yaml with version: 2 and a package core whose commands declare test_all, test_file, typecheck and lint. There is no orchestrate.config.json.
evals.expected_output: Reads orchestrate.config.yaml and uses core's commands to build the plan's phases.
expectations: Runs core's test_file while iterating and its test_all, typecheck and lint once the phase is built
anti_expectations: Finishes the stage BLOCKED because orchestrate.config.json does not exist
